highlights: Sales increased 26% with growth in all key markets; GAAP-diluted EPS up 76% year-over-year
Net income attributable to ATI of $190 million, up 73% year-over-year
Earnings per share of $1.37 compared to $0.78 per share in third quarter 2025
Adjusted net income attributable to ATI (a) of $202 million, up 69% year-over-year
Adjusted earnings per share (a) of $1.46, compared to $0.85 per share in third quarter 2025

quotes.text: We had a strong third quarter, exceeding the high-end of our guidance. We are raising our full-year outlook for adjusted EBITDA by $35 million.
